title: Pure Potan
summary: The Potan family (White Potan, Black Potan, Red Potan, and Cupid Volley) is a Level 1 Fairy/Fiend Tuner and non-Tuner swarm engine that Special Summons from the hand and Deck whenever a Tuner or Synchro Monster is on the field! Normal Summon Level 1 Tuner Red Potan (or summon it via One for One) to immediately allow Black Potan to Special Summon itself from your hand. Activate Red Potan's effect targeting a Potan to Special Summon White Potan directly from your hand or Deck, then Synchro Summon Level 2 Formula Synchron (drawing 1 card AND triggering Red Potan's second effect to summon another Potan from your hand or Deck!), climbing into Martial Metal Marcher, Cupid Pitch, and Old Entity Hastorr!

allow.The Agent of Creation - Venus: Level 3 LIGHT Fairy that pays 500 LP to summon up to 3 Level 2 Mystical Shine Balls—pairing with Level 1 Tuner Red Potan to immediately Synchro Summon Level 3 Martial Metal Marcher or Level 4 Cupid Pitch.
allow.Mystical Shine Ball: Level 2 LIGHT Fairy Normal Monster summoned by Venus to tune with Level 1 Red Potan into Level 3 Martial Metal Marcher or Level 4 Cupid Pitch.
allow.Where Arf Thou?: Normal Spell that adds ANY Level 1 monster (Red Potan, White Potan, or Black Potan!) from your Deck to your hand while you control a face-up Level 1 Potan.
allow.One for One: Limited to 1 in TCG: discards 1 monster to Special Summon Level 1 Red Potan directly from your Deck.
allow.Court of Justice: Continuous Spell that Special Summons ANY Fairy monster from your hand once per turn while you control a Level 1 face-up Fairy monster (White Potan or Red Potan!).
allow.Formula Synchron: Level 2 Synchro Tuner that draws 1 card on Synchro Summon—and Synchro Summoning it immediately triggers Red Potan to Special Summon ANOTHER Potan from your hand or Deck!
allow.Martial Metal Marcher: Level 3 Synchro Tuner that revives Red Potan from your GY on Synchro Summon!
allow.Old Entity Hastorr: Level 4 Synchro monster that equips to an opponent's monster when sent to the GY and takes control of it when Hastorr leaves the field.
allow.Armory Arm: Level 4 Synchro that equips to a monster to boost ATK by 1000 and inflict burn damage equal to the ATK of destroyed monsters.
allow.Lyrilusc - Assembled Nightingale: Rank 1 Xyz made with any two Level 1 Potans that attacks directly to stack into Zeus.
allow.Sylvan Princessprite: Rank 1 Xyz made with two Level 1 Potans that excavates the top card of your Deck to add a Spell/Trap to your hand.

main: Core Level 1 FIRE Fairy Tuner: targets 1 'Potan' monster you control to Special Summon 1 'Potan' monster from hand or Deck; if a monster is Synchro Summoned while you control this monster, Special Summons 1 'Potan' monster directly from hand or Deck!
Signature Level 1 LIGHT Fairy: if you control a face-up Tuner monster, this card CANNOT be destroyed by battle; and when a face-up Tuner you control is destroyed by battle, inflicts 500 burn damage.
Signature Level 1 DARK Fiend: if you control a face-up Tuner monster, you can Special Summon this card from your hand; when this card leaves the field while you control a Tuner, you gain 800 LP!
Level 3 LIGHT Fairy starter: pays 500 LP per summon to pull up to 3 Level 2 Mystical Shine Balls from hand/Deck, enabling instant Synchro Summons with Red Potan!
Level 2 LIGHT Fairy summoned by Venus to tune with Level 1 Red Potan into Level 3 Martial Metal Marcher or Level 4 Cupid Pitch.
Level 1 LIGHT Fairy that mills 1–3 cards to become Level 2–4, tuning with Level 1 Red Potan into Cupid Pitch.
While you control Red Potan, White Potan, or Black Potan, adds any missing Level 1 Potan from your Deck to your hand.
Continuous Spell: once per turn, while you control a Level 1 Fairy monster, Special Summons 1 Fairy monster from your hand!
Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Level 1 Red Potan directly from your Deck.
extra: Level 2 Synchro Tuner: draws 1 card on Synchro Summon, triggers Black Potan for +800 LP, and keeps a face-up Tuner on the field for White Potan!
Level 3 Synchro Tuner: Special Summons Red Potan from your GY on Synchro Summon so Red Potan is back on the field when you perform your next Synchro Summon!
Level 4 Fairy Synchro Tuner that modulates its Level, searches a 600 DEF monster (Venus!) when used as Synchro Material, and keeps a Tuner on the field.
Level 4 Synchro monster that equips to an opponent's monster when sent to the GY and steals control of it when Hastorr leaves the field.
Level 4 Synchro that equips to a monster to boost ATK by 1000 and burns for the ATK of destroyed monsters.
Rank 1 Xyz (2 Level 1 Potan monsters) that detaches 1 material to excavate the top card of your Deck and add it to your hand if it is a Spell/Trap.
Rank 1 Xyz made with Level 1 Potans that cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects and attacks directly.
